report.summary: Split the due-dates epic into three tickets: the store, the API, then the page.

artifacts.title: Plan: Due dates for todos
artifacts.markdown:
## Problem
Todos have no due date.

## Approach
- Store first, then the API, then the page, so each lands on working code.

## Out of scope
- Reminders.

## Risks and open questions
- Time zones: dates are plain YYYY-MM-DD.

## Size
M, as three tickets

acceptanceCriteria: A todo can have a due date, set through the API and shown on the page

proposedTickets.title: Store a due date on todos
Accept a due date in POST /api/todos
proposedTickets.descriptionMd: Pass `due` from the request body to the store.

proposedTickets.title: Show due dates on the page
proposedTickets.descriptionMd: Show each todo's due date after its title.
acceptanceCriteria: The page shows a todo's due date
